question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**away**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses a shift from a donor-recipient model to a more equitable system. The word **away** fits here, indicating the movement away from a model that reinforces power imbalances.
 
• **Away** suggests moving or transitioning from something, which aligns with the context of changing the structure of the fund and shifting away from a donor-recipient relationship.
 
• Other options such as **beside**, **during**, and **along** do not effectively convey the idea of moving away from an existing model or system.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *The US is the (1) **biggest **__shareholder in the World Bank and traditionally, the bank’s president has been a US citizen (2) __**nominated **__by Washington. Small island developing states have argued for moving the fund (3) __away__ from a donor recipient model, with all their usual power imbalances, (4)______ a partnership founded on a shared commitment to protecting the planet. This will require partial or total (5)_______ of the World Bank. This is already happening under its new president, some argue. But hosting the fund within the bank would still give donor countries disproportionate influence.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Beside** refers to being next to something, which does not fit the context of a change or shift from one model to another.
 
• **During** refers to something happening in the course of time, which does not fit the sense of changing or moving away from a model.
 
• **Along** suggests moving in a parallel direction, which does not capture the sense of distancing or transitioning from an old model.
